traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for 022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE are satisfied: - **Before/After/Mixed Positions**: Multiple passing tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts confirm traceability annotations work before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags. - **Proper Termination & JSDoc Tag Detection**: processCommentLine now calls isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine and finalizes any pending @story/@req when a non-traceability JSDoc tag line (any `@word` except @story/@req/@supports) is encountered, ensuring correct termination at tag boundaries. - **Continuation Logic & Preserve Multiline**: Continuation of multi-line values only occurs when the next normalized line is non-empty and not a JSDoc tag; tests show multi-line story values before other tags are preserved correctly. - **No False Positives & Error Messages**: The specific regression from Issue #3 (requirement IDs being concatenated with subsequent JSDoc tags) is covered by a valid test (“JSDoc tags do not pollute requirement ID when following @req”), and all existing invalid-format tests still pass, indicating real format errors still produce clear, actionable messages. - **Backward Compatibility**: The large existing suite for valid-annotation-format (including multi-line, configurable patterns, and @supports behavior) continues to pass, demonstrating no regressions. - **Documentation & Tests**: The rule documentation now has a dedicated JSDoc coexistence section with examples using this story, and the test file clearly references the story and all its requirement IDs via @story/@req annotations.
Given the implemented code, documentation updates, and passing targeted tests, this story is fully implemented and verified.
